prose: An Information excerpt indexed by Techmeme attributes proposed Muse Charm pricing and a temporary connectivity subsidy to an unnamed source. The primary report was inaccessible. Proposed terms are not a confirmed retail offer, and eligibility, geography, taxes and post-promotion charges could not be checked.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed source report
Proposed price is not a live offer
Connectivity subsidy is time limited in the account
Eligibility and later charges remain unverified
